text: Is a Mermaid flowchart with short notes, and covers both entry points: the login page and Account Settings.

Shows the authorization-code flow with PKCE, state and nonce. The attempt must finish within 10 minutes and be used once. An unknown, expired or reused state, or an error reported by Google (such as Cancel), ends without changing anything.
Matches Google accounts by sub only, one-to-one with users. A changed Google email still reaches the same account and never changes the stored email. No Google access or refresh tokens are kept.

Shows every sign-in callback outcome: a linked sub signs in; an unverified email is refused; a verified email with no match creates a verified user with no password and links it; a verified email matching an unlinked account requires that account's password; a matching account already linked to a different Google account is refused.
Password confirmation uses the existing lockout (5 failures, 15-minute lock), has a 10-minute window, and discards the pending link if the account locks.
Linking from settings needs no password or email match but refuses a Google account linked to another user. Unlinking is allowed only when the user has a password.
Every successful sign-in ends in the existing session mechanism: a sessions row and a sid cookie with 14-day expiry, with the old sid replaced.
States where each new piece of temporary and permanent state lives and what removes it, and what happens when the code exchange with Google fails.
